# Tuya TV Viewer v0.9.0: copyable logs and verified codecs

Experimental Android TV release. Fixes Copy Log so diagnostic lines remain readable while selectively redacting names, email addresses, credentials, and identifiers. Codec detection no longer relies on weak clues; the decoder starts only after coherent codec parameter sets and a keyframe are recognized. Adds one SDP fallback using the RTC `motoId` when the device does not answer the first offer. Python and Java tests passed. Streaming on LSC cameras was not yet guaranteed; no video stream or personal data was saved to GitHub. Package and Android name are unchanged, but varying debug signatures may require uninstalling the previous build.
